name: FileToPDF
desc: Convert files, HTML, and Markdown to PDF. Office documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX), images, web pages, and Markdown become clean PDFs over a simple API.

actions.name: convert_file
actions.description: Convert an uploaded file or a public file URL to PDF. The engine is chosen automatically from the extension — Office (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX…), images, HTML, Markdown, or PDF passthrough.

actions.name: convert_html
actions.description: Render a raw HTML string (with optional CSS) to PDF using Chromium.

actions.name: convert_markdown
actions.description: Render a raw Markdown string (with optional CSS) to PDF. A sensible default stylesheet is applied when no CSS is provided.

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Read the workspace plan, remaining credits, and subscription status. Free — never consumes credits.
